findings: DynastyMerit full class corroborates earlier consumer contract: six bounded one-shot event IDs and eighteen bounded first-obtain IDs; root flags are set before addMerit. Preserve these receipts rather than deriving them from advancement/inventory or executing event/obtain callbacks.

Kill merit amount<100 uses a paired root long wall-clock window and int earned; reset only now-window>600000 then cap120. These are economic anti-farm state, not disposable combat animation cooldown; do not refresh window or zero spent budget during Clone. This is a static inspection, no real clock test.

Manual giveOnce sets root dynasty_manual_given before inventory/drop and calls RankPerks only on the unclaimed branch. Preserve true claim without reissuing item; missing claim may cause starter gift and welcome messages on a later login, not a guarantee that every death immediately invokes PlayerLoggedInEvent.

Festival_day is an automatic-host daily stamp, not a cosmetic last-seen field: WorldEvents writes it before trigger. Trigger gives all current level players items/effects; spring additionally adds loyalty5 and attempts fireworks/nian. Restore the stored string unchanged without calling trigger.

Automatic festival semantics are not globally once-per-day: each unstamped player invokes a level-wide trigger, so several unstamped players may each trigger benefits for the whole level. Copying one host stamp prevents that host replay, not all other hosts. This supplemental source reading does not implement or authorize a new festival redesign.

FestivalLanternItem directly invokes trigger with a 200tick item cooldown and no daily stamp check/write or stack shrink in this use method; outside festival only40tick cooldown. Preserving the auto-host stamp must not be claimed to enforce a global reward-once rule or change existing manual lantern semantics.

Festival give helper ignores inventory.add return with no drop/escrow in this class. Existing grant-before-delivery paths do not prove crash-atomic or guaranteed full-inventory rewards; migrating receipts must not regenerate goods to repair ambiguous history.

WorldEvents kill callback also changes loyalty/rebellion repeatedly for selected kills; those mutations are gameplay events, never safe migration restore APIs. Root restore should set exact typed data without invoking kill, event, festival, grant or pickup callbacks.
proposed_verification_cases: Exact typed root values including explicitly stored zero survive owned same-UUID death/nondeath clone; absent keys stay absent, wrong-type data does not silently turn into a fresh reward entitlement.
Nested firstkill true/root absent retains award guard and restores equivalent root-only consumers without invoking reward; contradictory alias precedence requires explicit reviewed policy.
Preserve gift flags plus boss-kind list/count, six event/eighteen pickup receipts and spent kill budget; second player retains independent values.
Keep inherited Persisted/slot/school/army handlers compatible; old/new compounds independent; guide/warm/continuous challenge resets remain effective.
Keep original festival host stamp exact across death; do not claim suppression of unrelated player hosts or manually used lantern.
Offline serialization cases are separate from real TCP clone/rejoin and historical item mappings; those product acceptances remain pending.
